reason_for_separate_cell_freeze: The first frozen protocol's 192-token text stream is appropriate for the short burst trace but may finish before the 12-image uniform trace ends. This uniform cell lengthens text generation while retaining the same server, image payload size and arrival spacing.

cell.purpose: Observe scheduler-native queue snapshots under repeated low-rate image arrivals with sustained text decode; do not extrapolate the burst fit or activate any controller action.

analysis: Capture the latest scheduler snapshot immediately before each image submission, with broker receive age.
Join each image request to engine submission, first encoder scheduler admission, visual CUDA event and client TTFT.
Report text lane activity, scheduler queue counters and missing/stale observations descriptively; no hard success threshold is used.
Do not alter the already sealed DocVQA heldout or any quality calibration.

source_constraints.Flickr: No API key, API call, page or image URL.
